name: Gallery Talk with Pia Camil
description: Get a unique insight into the Mexican artist's practice ahead of her exhibition opening. A fantastic opportunity for art lovers to engage directly with a creator.
longDescription:
This event is a gallery talk featuring Mexican artist Pia Camil, hosted by the Galeria Municipal do Porto. The discussion offers an opportunity to learn about Camil's artistic methods and influences directly from the artist, preceding the opening of her new exhibition at the venue. It is designed to provide context and deeper understanding of her work for those interested in contemporary art.

Attendees can expect a focused conversation, likely lasting around an hour, conducted in a gallery setting. The event is open to the public and caters to individuals with an interest in contemporary art and artistic processes. The Galeria Municipal do Porto provides a formal yet accessible environment for such discussions.

The event is free to attend. The Galeria Municipal do Porto is located within walking distance of Casa da Música metro station (lines A, B, C, E, F).
